name: @psyb0t/reverse-engineer-anything
summary: Wire an OpenClaw agent to a self-hosted REA reverse-engineering container over MCP.
description: A thin stdio<->HTTP bridge that connects an MCP client to a running reverse-engineer-anything container's MCP endpoint (/mcp). The container runs REA (rea-agents, https://github.com/morluto/rea) and exposes its full tool catalog: Android APK analysis through JADX and Apktool (package overview, class search, decompiled classes and methods, reference tracing, decoded resources), adb device tools, JavaScript/Electron, .NET, Go and Rust binary inspection, WASM, SQLite and network captures. You run the container yourself and point this bridge at it; analyze only software you are authorized to examine. See https://github.com/psyb0t/docker-reverse-engineer-anything.

REA_URL.description: Base URL of your running container, e.g. http://localhost:8080 (the bridge appends /mcp).

REA_BRIDGE_TOKEN.description: Bearer token the container was started with (REA_BRIDGE_TOKEN). Sent to REA_URL as an Authorization header.

url.description: Base URL of your running container, e.g. http://localhost:8080 (the bridge appends /mcp).

token.description: Bearer token the container was started with (REA_BRIDGE_TOKEN).
